citations.quote: The general requirement in Basel I that banks hold a total capital equal to 8% of risk-weighted assets (RWA) remains unchanged.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: The Basel lineage builds bank capital off risk-weighted assets: the Cooke ratio and RWA in Basel I, three pillars plus IRB in Basel II, and the CET1/AT1/Tier-2 stack with conservation/countercyclical buffers, a 3% leverage ratio, and LCR/NSFR in Basel III, per Hull Ch.25–26.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Basel Capital Accords I → II → II.5 → III: The Regulatory-Capital Workflow
